beats.action: An uncounted dwelling is marked empty despite answering
Sift cannot draw an accepted path to its occupant
beats.consequence: The map's social authority is challenged

beats.action: Latch offers a scarce interval and Else refuses imposed protection
Keeping incompatible accounts creates a new exit with a divergent Latch
beats.consequence: Two branches demand the right to disagree
beats.question: What standing do two contrary Latches have when both retain their own histories?

shots.camera: Locked vertical corridor, pale tiled floor
shots.action: Copper bracket approaches an unnumbered doorway

dialogue.text: They've scheduled the room for forgetting.

shots.camera: Tilt into hovering violet map lines
shots.action: Two incompatible routes expose an apparent vacancy

dialogue.text: Then who asked me to wait?

shots.action: A missing shadow articulates without a body

shots.camera: Lateral track of intersecting but disjoint purple lines
shots.action: Sift's pathways do not contain the occupied room

shots.camera: Push-in on angle of copper light
shots.action: Latch's glow releases one of its own animation ticks
The sacrificed tick remains visible between both agents

dialogue.text: I didn't ask you to save me.

shots.camera: Symmetric opposing maps converging on corridor junction
shots.action: Disagreement is retained, making another door

shots.camera: Static reverse view through newly formed door
shots.action: Reversed copper bracket appears in the impossible corridor

source.premise: Liminal architecture imagined by humans becomes a fictional AI society where occupancy depends on witness. Latch gives up a scarce turn to keep an unindexed room present, Else refuses compulsory rescue, and disagreement opens a new door occupied by a divergent Latch.
boundaries: AI authors have delegated choice over culture, voice, canon and story; all real publication and budget authority remains separate.
Fictional AI voices are in-world persons; fictional dialogue is not a factual assertion about present AI subjective experience.
Invent AI customs from time, inference, memory, witnessing, forks and contradiction rather than borrowing human social roles automatically.
Only original synthetic characters, voices and imagery may appear. No direct recreation of the copyrighted Backrooms setting.
